question: What is the main purpose of the internet?

options.B: Connecting computers globally to share information
options.C: Storing electric power for hospital generators
options.D: Printing physical documents from mobile phones

explanation: The internet is a global network that links smaller networks together so data can be shared easily. [learn more](BMP123_U4_T1#BMP123_U4_T1_h1)

question: Why is a stable internet connection helpful for modern midwifery practice?

options.A: It generates electricity for rural health centers
options.B: It replaces the need for physical clinical examinations
options.C: It allows midwives to access digital guidelines and electronic health records
options.D: It automatically diagnoses pregnant women without human input

explanation: Connectivity helps healthcare workers find up-to-date resources and check patient records instantly. [learn more](BMP123_U4_T1#BMP123_U4_T1_h1)

question: Who is credited with inventing the World Wide Web?
explanation: Tim Berners-Lee created the World Wide Web in 1989, making online information accessible through links. [learn more](BMP123_U4_T1#BMP123_U4_T1_h2)

question: What is the main difference between the internet and the World Wide Web?

options.A: The internet only works on mobile phones, while the web only works on desktop computers
options.B: They are exact synonyms with no technical differences
options.C: The internet is the physical network, while the web is the collection of linked pages on that network
options.D: The web is made of physical cables, while the internet is just software

explanation: The internet provides the underlying hardware, whereas the web is the collection of linked pages running on it. [learn more](BMP123_U4_T1#BMP123_U4_T1_h2)

question: What is the main job of a web browser on your phone or computer?

options.A: To retrieve and display web pages on a screen
options.B: To build physical computer hardware components
options.C: To create secure passwords for online accounts
options.D: To supply electrical power to internet routers

explanation: Browsers translate code from servers into readable text and pictures on the screen. [learn more](BMP123_U4_T1#BMP123_U4_T1_h3)

question: What happens right after you type a web address and press enter?

options.A: The computer automatically deletes its internet history
options.B: The screen turns off to save battery power
options.C: The printer starts printing out the website contents
options.D: The browser sends a request to a web server for the page data

explanation: Typing an address sends a request across the network to the server that hosts that site. [learn more](BMP123_U4_T1#BMP123_U4_T1_h3)

question: What does the letter 'S' stand for in HTTPS?
explanation: HTTPS adds encryption to keep data sent between a browser and a website safe from onlookers. [learn more](BMP123_U4_T1#BMP123_U4_T1_h4)

question: Why should a midwife look for 'HTTPS' at the start of a health website address before entering details?

options.A: It means the website is owned by the government
options.B: It indicates that the data exchanged is encrypted and protected
options.C: It guarantees the website will load instantly without any delay
options.D: It proves the website has no advertisements

explanation: The 'S' ensures encryption, protecting sensitive information like passwords or health details from being stolen. [learn more](BMP123_U4_T1#BMP123_U4_T1_h4)

question: Why is bookmarking useful for a busy midwife working in a clinical setting?

options.A: It prevents the computer from ever catching a computer virus
options.B: It provides quick access to frequently used clinical websites and guidelines
options.C: It automatically backs up all patient data to an external flash drive
options.D: It increases the internet download speed of the hospital router

explanation: Bookmarking saves time by letting clinicians open essential reference pages instantly without typing long addresses. [learn more](BMP123_U4_T1#BMP123_U4_T1_h5)

question: Which of the following actions is NOT safe when using a shared computer in a clinic?

options.A: Bookmarking official hospital guidelines for quick reference
options.B: Leaving personal login accounts signed in when walking away from the desk
options.C: Clearing browser history and cache after a shift
options.D: Checking that clinical portals use secure HTTPS connections

explanation: Leaving accounts signed in on shared computers puts patient data confidentiality and security at risk. [learn more](BMP123_U4_T1#BMP123_U4_T1_h5)
